scope: Hosted evidence receipts, cumulative ledgers and milestone release packets
recommended_architecture: GitHub Actions artifact for immediate run recovery
Hugging Face dataset repository for content-addressed machine-readable receipt bundles
Zenodo deposition for milestone packets and long-term DOI preservation
Git history for manifests, pointers, schemas and decision records
controls: Independent target receipts with exact bundle digest
No promotion when a required target is pending or digest-mismatched
No local checkout treated as authoritative storage
Retention and replication status exposed in Conductor evidence

contingencies.huggingface_unavailable: Retain GitHub artifact and queue a bounded retry; do not mark preservation qualified
contingencies.zenodo_unavailable: Retain GitHub artifact and queue a bounded retry; do not issue a milestone DOI claim
contingencies.both_unavailable: Keep the campaign running for operational observation but block preservation and release promotion
contingencies.credential_missing: Generate the manifest and explicit pending-target receipt without printing or storing credentials

verified_targets.scope: Protected-main campaign receipts and cumulative ledger through 2026-08-19

pending_targets.reason: Zenodo deposition is a deliberate milestone action and requires a final packet plus DOI receipt

current_state: Hugging Face replication verified; Zenodo milestone deposition remains pending; local checkout is not authoritative storage
